contracts.input_status: all V2 inputs are observed development/regression inputs
contracts.resolver: unchanged exact single transposition; small n<=16 rational fallback; otherwise unresolved
contracts.reset: fixed root factor within worker; empty request Gram/answer caches

semantic_comparison_schema.integer_policy: arbitrary precision JSON integers; no floating normalization
semantic_comparison_schema.request_memory_policy: only the listed resource fields are excluded; all other memory fields are preserved
semantic_comparison_schema.diagnostic_cache_policy: compare exactly for same-build diagnosis; unavailable in historical V3 and excluded only in historical mode
semantic_comparison_schema.environment_and_source_policy: validated separately against each frozen binding

observation_scope: fixed-count len/nbytes/existing counters only; all recursive reports and factor-step byte scans disabled for light_v1; named shared payloads are not summed as total memory
main_time_definition: graph-load and structural preparation + all actual full-request walls, including necessary light observations and original G lazy import
process_wall_definition: separate full child lifetime including imports, bindings, checkpoints, serialization and diagnosis-only scans; never added to service
resource_observation_scope: supervisor 100ms RSS/VMS sampled maxima; worker ru_maxrss through last read before final JSON serialization; hard2GiB address-space limit

selection_rule.complete_gate: five original complete cells each have all three paired repeats, plus binding, semantics and resources
selection_rule.R: sum H service / sum G service over fifteen complete pairs
selection_rule.r_i: median of three within-cell paired H/G ratios
selection_rule.stability_ruling: repeat-specific aggregate guard resolves undefined fluctuation clause before timing; no significance claim
selection_rule.otherwise: retain current H default; report mixed/insufficient evidence; no extra repeats

stop: no source changes after formal freeze; no replacement of completed worker; gate failure stops; no optimization loop
verification: no new full-domain numerical replay; exact same-method logged semantics, plus diagnostic-only final cache/step digests
